findings.title: Deployed yt-dlp cannot produce a usable source asset
findings.reproduction: Call preview /api/media/preflight for on-and-on and invincible on either exact-SHA diagnostic deployment.
findings.actual: Four uncached attempts, both pinned SDK versions, return503 source_access_restricted after passing generated storage/ranges.
findings.impact: Custom playback, first audio latency, live quality, seeking/renewal and background playback cannot be qualified.
findings.recommendedFix: Provide a working authorized source/hosting environment and repeat uncached extraction, actual delivery and decoding before switching provider or activation.

findings.title: Public native binaries do not play the tested songs
findings.reproduction: Install the production-offered Windows EXE or APK in a fresh profile. Play the recorded first search result, then Next.
findings.actual: Selection works but timeline remains0; public APK provider response is LOGIN_REQUIRED / bot confirmation and error150.
findings.impact: Core listening blocked for the tested sources/environments.
findings.recommendedFix: Complete the source-gated yt-dlp replacement. Do not equate UI/selection success with playback.

findings.title: Retired Android binding reauthorizes a stale Play
findings.reproduction: B1 PlayW1/PauseW2, rebindB2/PauseW1, fresh-grant rebindB1 and replay original PlayW1.
findings.actual: Only the opt-in retired-binding case fails in each21-test API33/API36 suite;20 other cases pass per API.
findings.impact: A malformed binding sequence can override later Pause. Normal client generates fresh IDs; no ordinary-client or physical audible restart proved.
findings.recommendedFix: Jointly agree native-issued identities or bounded history with capacity/recovery/legacy rules, implement, enable regression and rerun both actual-service suites.

findings.title: Public Windows automatic update delivery disabled
findings.reproduction: Install public1.0.0, open Settings and run the actual native update check; read stable manifest/feed.
findings.actual: state:disabled, no signed stable release, published:false/signed:false and latest.yml404; installer NotSigned.
findings.impact: Existing users cannot receive the intended native update.
findings.recommendedFix: Configure signing/publish a valid verified stable release/feed under separate release authorization. Never force readiness flags.
